description: This file defines the EmployeePersonalDetailModel class, a PHP model used within the OrangeHRM system to represent employee personal details, including serialization and configuration traits. It includes OpenAPI schema annotations and constructors to initialize the model with an Employee entity.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailModel
